notes: Entry = the $24M Series A led by Benchmark (company release on GlobeNewswire, 2024-09-16: 'with participation from Quiet Capital, SV Angel, Abstract Ventures, Lux Capital, Operator Partners, Visionaries, Activant, HubSpot Ventures, Project A, 20VC, 20Growth, and 20Sales'). TechCrunch/Maginative give shorter lists without Visionaries. Visionaries is absent from the $2M pre-seed (tech.eu 2023-08-14: Project A lead, Sequoia/Accel/Atomic scouts, NoLabel, Tiny VC), so the Series A is the first Visionaries check. Series B $50M led by a16z (release 2024-11-11 lists Visionaries among backers). vehicle_hint Growth Fund II comes from a WebSearch summary of a vendor profile ('Visionaries Club Early Growth Fund II'), not verified. The $350M valuation is TechCrunch's sourced report for the Series B ('around $350 million', pre/post not stated), not a company statement. Founded 2022 in London, HQ moved to San Francisco in 2024 (TechCrunch). CEO Hasan Sukkar replaced May 2025 (TechCrunch/Bloomberg headlines 2025-05-05); no later round found (Google News to 2026-09). Sibling rows (a16z, 20VC) agree on HQ, focus and the Series A/B facts.
